name: WordPress
description: Verify a scoped WordPress Application Password through one read-only identity check.

methods.label: Use an Application Password
methods.whenToUse: Use a dedicated WordPress Application Password for a masked read-only authentication check.
methods.guidanceMd: This connector exposes only a masked users/me authentication check. Bind it to one Paperclip project and an explicit agent allowlist.

tenantFields.label: WordPress base URL
tenantFields.helperMd: HTTPS only. Do not include wp-json, credentials, query parameters, or fragments.

tenantFields.label: Paperclip project ID
tenantFields.helperMd: Calls outside this exact project are denied.

tenantFields.label: Allowed agent IDs
tenantFields.helperMd: Comma-separated Paperclip agent IDs. Every other agent is denied.

credentialFields.label: WordPress Application Password
credentialFields.placeholder: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

warnings: Read-only authentication check only. This connection cannot create, update, delete, publish, or otherwise write WordPress content.
